text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident fired for service `inference-regional-01` (high p50 latency). Pager: @eng-oncall. Trigger: p50 >= 200ms over 1m (6 events). https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-2145002222 :rotating_light:
Kenji: taking this — I'm on-call. pinging metrics + traces.
Kenji: quick check: nodes look ok, 1 deployment (runtime-v2) had a cpu spike. pulling recent pods logs.
Kenji: ```
kubectl top pod runtime-v2-7f9d  # CPU 92%
# logs show repeated KV cache miss and evictions
[2026-03-14T21:03:10Z] kv_cache: miss key=prefix-42
[2026-03-14T21:03:11Z] kv_cache: miss key=prefix-43
```
Maya: any customer impact yet? are requests erroring or just slower?
Kenji: no 5xx. Just added tail latency for some requests to /v1/generate. Traces show cold kv-cache rehydration during a traffic ramp — looks like a brief warmup storm.
Nora: saw similar blips earlier this week after deploys. Could be autoscaler churn + cold cache.
Kenji: paging notes to PD: acked and investigating. I scaled deployment to 6 -> 8 replicas temporarily and forced kv warmup on a subset.
Kenji: runbook step run: ```
POST /internal/kv/warm?prefix=common-requests
# invoked warmup on 2 pods
```
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident status updated -> acknowledged by Kenji. escalation level 1.
Lee: on standby to take handoff in 10m if still open.
Kenji: metrics already trending back down — p50 dropping below 200ms after warmup (about ~90s after action). No customer-facing errors recorded in Sentry.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident auto-resolved (no longer triggered) after 3m. Incident closed by system.
Maya: thanks. Can we add a short postmortem line and a follow-up to lower sensitivity during warmup windows?
Kenji: created ticket RW-2319: "Reduce sensitivity on p50 alert during autoscaler/rollout windows + add kv-cache warmup as pre-hook". Assigning to eng-runtime and eng-sre.
Nora: suggestion: add a temporary suppression rule for rollout windows or require sustained >3m before paged.
Kenji: agreed. I'll paste a draft of an alert tweak to the ticket. :thumbsup:
Maya: brief customer impact note for the status page: "brief latency increase for a small fraction of requests in region A from 21:03–21:06 UTC, no errors or request loss." I'll add to the ticket.
Kenji: closing thread here — follow-up in RW-2319. Thanks all.
